olivia (compliance): Heads up — quarterly access review kicking off. Please claim owners for any roles you maintain by EOD next Thu. Link: https://redwood.internal/access-reviews/5239 :eyes:

maria (sec-eng): Noted. Two quick things — we still have the KMS audit-log gap for projects using the on‑prem KMS proxy. Last week's ingest dropped 7 keys. Filing bug CV-587.

samir (cloud-ops): can you paste the key ids? I can run a reingest. Also are we sure CloudTrail was enabled for those accounts?

maria (sec-eng): Key ids: key-27f, key-8a2, key-0b9. Confirmed CT enabled but the log forwarder crashed during rotation window. Here's quick probe I ran:
```
aws cloudtrail lookup-events --lookup-attributes AttributeKey=ResourceName,AttributeValue=arn:aws:kms:...:key-27f | jq '.Events[] | {EventTime,EventName,Username}'
```

devon (platform): For the review, I'd like to minimize noisy owners. Suggest a scheduled query to find ownerless admin bindings across org: 
```
SELECT service, binding, array_length(members) AS n FROM rbac.bindings WHERE role LIKE '%admin' AND array_length(members)=0;
```
I'll add this as a daily job while the sweep runs.

olivia (compliance): Nice. We also need to check retention TTLs — audit logs for KMS proxies are 30d in staging but 90d in prod. Please standardize to 180d for keys with privileged access.

samir (cloud-ops): I'll change retention policy, but need approval for cost impact. Quick estimate: +12GB/month across prod. @finance FYI :money_with_wings: 

maria (sec-eng): Also recommending a temporary canary that enforces least-priv (remove iam:AdminAccess) from 10 low-risk service accounts first. Rollback plan: automated rebind if errors >5% within a 1hr window.

devon (platform): Agree. Can we route backup traffic to Dedicated during the canary? Want to avoid overload on hosted endpoints.

olivia (compliance): OK let's ship plan. Owners: maria — canary plan + rollback; devon — routing + automation; samir — log retention + reingest; olivia — compliance evidence. Target start: 2025-04-08 09:00 PT. Please ack.

maria (sec-eng): ack
samir (cloud-ops): ack
devon (platform): ack
access-bot: Automated note: created task RW-ACC-2025-04-canary in Jira and assigned to maria,devon,samir,olivia. Link: https://jira.redwood.ai/browse/RW-ACC-2025-04-canary

olivia (compliance): Thanks — I'll include this in the audit packet. If anyone finds ownerless bindings outside the sweep please ping me directly.

devon (platform): quick followup — do we need to rotate keys for those orphaned bindings before reassigning? That would be safer.

maria (sec-eng): yes, rotate + backfill owner metadata. I'll add a rotation job to the canary playbook.

samir (cloud-ops): On reingest: I scheduled a reprocess for the missing KMS events at 03:30 PT tomorrow.

olivia (compliance): perfect. closing loop for now. :white_check_mark:
